nominee.longerDescription: Happy Ww! I am nominating Nathalie Mcgloin, the first female disabled racer! I saw her on the career ladder, because the host started a new spin off where he interviews disabled ppl since he broke his leg so he himself cannot get on the ladder either. Lowkey funny a bit that he only started featuring when he also experienced disabilities but oh well. For me its a bit hard to imagine how one can be so strong of a character to be this driven despite their circumstances since they must be running into blockers in all aspects of life. I originally planned someone else for this week but she moved me (no pun, sorry) so much that I decided to have her this week. Also, what sealed the deal was that she is racing in a Porsche 🐎Hype 4/10, motivation 8/10!
